enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Take out cereal. Close cupboard. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Place bowl in sink. Place spoon in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Open drawer. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close drawer. Take off pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on socks. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone for time. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to workplace.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Greet patients. Check schedules. Review patient charts. Wash hands. Put on gloves. Take vitals. Administer medication. Update records. Consult with colleagues. Answer phone. Respond to emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Break for lunch. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Write reports. Clean equipment. Wash hands. Remove gloves. End shift.

Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Walk to seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Check phone. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Open door. Enter home.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out pan. Take out knife. Take out cutting board. Close cupboard. Wash vegetables. Cut vegetables. Cut meat. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Add meat. Stir with spatula. Add spices. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Open drawer. Take out fork. Close drawer. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Wash hands. Wipe mouth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Browse internet. Watch video. Check social media. Type message. Send message. Close laptop. Put laptop down. Pick up remote. Change channel. Watch TV. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Open drink. Drink. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check phone. Scroll. Put phone down. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Wait for water to heat. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bed. Pull back blanket. Lie down. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to side. Adjust blanket. Sleep.
